about: RCSB Protein Data Bank (rcsb.org): search 3D macromolecular structures by keyword, attribute or 3D shape, and fetch entry chains, sequence annotations, UniProt alignments, version history, ligand definitions and coordinate/FASTA files.

commands.summary: Full-text keyword search of PDB entries (e.g. 'hemoglobin'), with sorting and offset pagination; returns PDB IDs, titles, methods, organisms and ligands

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sort key: relevance score or initial release date

params.name: direction
params.description: Sort direction. Use desc with the release date to get the newest entries first.

params.name: content_type
params.description: experimental = PDB entries; computational = computed structure models (CSM)

commands.summary: Keyword search of PDB entries refined by one facet filter (source organism, experimental method, etc.), with sorting and pagination

params.name: filter_attribute
params.description: Facet attribute to refine on (exact match)

params.name: filter_value
params.description: Exact facet value, e.g. 'Homo sapiens' for organism, or 'X-RAY DIFFRACTION', 'ELECTRON MICROSCOPY' or 'SOLUTION NMR' for exptl.method

commands.summary: Search PDB entries by a structured attribute such as author name, source organism, gene name or experimental method

params.name: attribute
params.description: Search attribute path. Examples: audit_author.name, rcsb_entity_source_organism.ncbi_scientific_name, rcsb_entity_source_organism.rcsb_gene_name.value, exptl.method, struct.title

params.name: value
params.description: Value to match, e.g. 'HBB', 'Perutz, M.F.' or 'Homo sapiens'

commands.summary: 3D shape similarity search: find biological assemblies structurally similar to a given entry's assembly

params.name: entry_id
params.description: PDB ID of the query structure

params.name: assembly_id
params.description: Assembly ID of the query structure (see get-structure-chains)

commands.summary: Autocomplete: suggested search terms (molecule names, keywords, organisms...) for a partial query, grouped by attribute
List the assemblies and polymer chains (entity id, name, label/auth asym ids) of a PDB entry
Get all polymer chains of a PDB entry, with molecule names, organisms, sequence lengths, method, resolution and assembly composition (Data API GraphQL)
Get the chain instances of one polymer entity (e.g. 4HHB_2), with molecule name, organism, length, method and resolution (Data API GraphQL)

params.name: entity_ids
params.description: Polymer entity ID in the form <PDBID>_<entity number>, e.g. 4HHB_1

commands.summary: Align a PDB entity or chain sequence to its UniProt reference sequence, with coverage and aligned regions (Sequence Coordinates API)

params.name: queryId
params.description: Entity ID (4HHB_2) when from=PDB_ENTITY, or chain instance ID (4HHB.B) when from=PDB_INSTANCE

commands.summary: Get positional sequence annotations (Pfam domains, disorder, secondary structure, binding sites, unobserved residues, UniProt features) for a PDB chain or entity

params.name: queryId
params.description: Chain instance ID (4HHB.B) when reference=PDB_INSTANCE, or entity ID (4HHB_2) when reference=PDB_ENTITY

commands.summary: Get the title and IDs of a PDB entry from its structure summary page
List the domain classification rows (SCOP/SCOPe, CATH, ECOD, etc.) for a PDB entry
Get the experimental method (X-ray, EM, NMR...) and experiment page title for a PDB entry
List the revision history of a PDB entry (version number, date, change type), with links to versioned files
Download the FASTA sequences of all polymer entities in a PDB entry as text
Fetch a PDB entry's coordinate file (mmCIF or legacy PDB) as text, either full or header-only

params.name: part
params.description: header = metadata only (small); view = full coordinates (can be large)

commands.summary: Get the chemical component definition (name, formula, synonyms, atoms, bonds) of a ligand as mmCIF text, e.g. HEM

params.name: ligand_id
params.description: Chemical component ID (1-5 chars), e.g. HEM, ATP, NAG
